profile.headline: Senior Front End Software Engineer at Acquia | 🏳️‍🌈
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a design background and a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Angular, Typescript, Javascript, HTML, CSS, LESS, SASS, Bootstrap, unit testing with Jasmine, end to end testing with Chai, integrating with a REST API, A11y WCAG experience, Gulp, NPM, Git, Github, Jira and Scrum/Agile.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Front End
positions.description:
•	Lead Developer on a project to create and implement a new Acquia Design System (component library) to be used across all of Acquia’s products resulting in a cleaner, more consistent and polished look. Responsible for story breakdown and estimation. Collaborated with Engineering Management and PM and led standups. Tools and technologies included HTML, CSS, SASS, CSS- grid, flexbox, Git, Github, Visual Studio, Jira for story tracking and Cypress screenshot testing

•	Migrated Acquia’s Cloud Platform from AngularJS to Angular. This involved switching from Javascript to Typescript, Jasmine for unit testing, NPM, Git, Github, Jira, Gulp, integrating with a REST API and applying changes based on WCAG.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Write clean, performant, tested code for the Acquia Cloud user interface using Angular and Typescript
•	Collaborate with Front End and Back End Engineers, UX Designers and Project Managers to achieve the goals of our product roadmap.
•	Designed and built the Enhance page in Acquia's Cloud Platform which advertises Acquia's other products.
•	Created animations for welcome screens which were shown to users while adding their first application.
•	Technologies and tools include Angular, Typescript, LESS, SASS, Jasmine, NPM, Gulp, Jira/Confluence, Git, Github and Visual Studio.

positions.title: HTML Developer
positions.description: Provided HTML and CSS support for alumni.harvard.edu, Alumni Magnet and additional Alumni Affairs and Development web presences

positions.title: Product Template Developer
positions.description: Developed templates for Constant Contact’s email editor SaaS while assuring the highest rendering standards across desktop, mobile, and tablet. Tools used were HTML, CSS3, Sublime Text, Git, Jira, and Grunt.  Used Agile Methodology including 2 week sprints.

positions.title: HTML Email Developer
positions.description: Developed responsive HTML emails that looked great across desktop, tablet, and mobile using Dreamweaver, Photoshop, HTML and CSS media queries to be sent to  millions of Constant Contact’s customers.

positions.title: UI UX Designer
positions.description:
•	Created graphic layouts & UX based on requirements provided through wireframes.
•	Designed consumer emails and online storefronts
•	Designed web pages and produced graphics used by developers.
•	Extended pre-defined design themes to new sites sections.
•	Conceptualized and created intuitive, engaging, and brand-consistent user interfaces for our websites, taking language translations into consideration.

positions.description: Developed a new website and HTML emails. My tools were HTML, CSS, Javascript and Photoshop.

positions.description: Developed front end code for the company website using HTML, CSS, Photoshop, Visual Studio and ASP.net Storefront. Designed and  developed emails and used Google Analytics to track results.

positions.title: HTML Email Newsletter Developer - Contract
positions.description: Developed email newsletters and sent them out to subscriber lists with as many as 2 million subscribers. Worked with DreamMail, Sharepoint, and Documentum.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer (clients: Sears, Kmart, Craftsman, Kenmore, Wal-Mart)
positions.description:
Front End Developer - Developed code for Sears Holdings Corporation’s websites using HTML, CSS, and Javascript, then loaded them to the websites using IBM's Websphere.  Regularly checked for and corrected cross-browser compatibility issues. Gained experience in quickly and accurately troubleshooting code. 

Email Developer – Developed emails using Dreamweaver for marketing campaigns going out to lists with millions of subscribers for Sears, Kmart, The Great Indoors, Kenmore, Craftsman, etc. Reviewed each email in various email clients to check for consistency. 

Digital Image Editor/Processor – Edited product images in Photoshop to match the client's (Wal-Mart.com) specifications which included sizing, color correction, colorizations, clippings, retouching, removing shadows, adding logos, etc. as well as keeping naming conventions and organizing images.
